data.body:
Live Bedrock confirmation of the fixed runner (worktree fix-sampling, uncommitted fix; AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock, us-west-2, 2026-11-11 PST). Each row drives `PydanticAIRunner.run()` with `temperature=0.0` requested, real `BedrockConverseModel`, botocore `_make_api_call` spied to record the `inferenceConfig` actually sent:

- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5: inferenceConfig {maxTokens: 64} -> response OK
- us.anthropic.claude-opus-5: {maxTokens: 64} -> OK
- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5: {maxTokens: 64} -> OK
- us.openai.gpt-5.5: {maxTokens: 64} -> OK
- us.moonshotai.kimi-k3.1: {maxTokens: 64} -> OK
- us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (positive control): {maxTokens: 64, temperature: 0.0} -> OK

On origin/main the same request for opus-5 / sonnet-5 / gpt-5.5 / kimi-k3.1 carries temperature 0.0, which the raw probe shows is rejected with 400.

Unit state after fix: `tests/unit/test_sampling_opt_in.py` 37 passed; targeted LLM suites 197 passed; ruff, mypy, complexity ratchet (exit 0), mechanism ratchet (exit 0) clean. The retry wrapper adds no lock/env/config: the runtime-rejection record is a module-level set in capabilities.py (not a mechanism kind the ratchet censuses; `check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 with no marker).
